title: 发现并填满可用步骤容量，恢复L4优先流水线
facts: 16:47 Asia/Shanghai API concurrency settings: Agent=4, API=8; monitor showed 3 active tasks, so capacity was not full.
L4工伤 answer completed; ordinal 6 was ready. Dispatched scoring attempt 4154feac-ef1d-4f62-8890-d9eec8703f27.

Two existing L2 workflows with current complete answers, repair decisions and author readiness were dispatched for new author attempts: partnership 83e292a1-7361-4dd5-b2d5-972934611316; transport regression 41f5f729-8322-4783-af1c-55380a073a98.
After dispatch, API monitor showed 5 active tasks: 3 Agent tasks (L4 scoring plus 2 L2 authoring) and 2 API answer tasks (L2 labor and decoration).
L4 civil-loan version remains draft; its downstream steps are not ready. No old answer or score reused. L3 remains excluded.
Siriser submitted count is still locally recorded as 16; count increases only after a newly accepted and archived L4 package is submitted and confirmed.
impact: The hour-long flat submission count was caused by a lack of a newly accepted-and-archived L4 candidate, with mandatory per-question answer/score/decision/archive dependencies; one L4 was draft. Available execution capacity had not been filled. The immediate route now advances L4 scoring and uses available capacity for authorized L2 work without changing model settings or thresholds.

updates.action: 派发L4工伤当前版本独立评分
用空闲Agent容量派发两个ready的L2出题步骤
updates.result: partnership and transport regression attempts entered running; monitor then showed 5 active tasks

lesson: Optimize by advancing each question to its next ready step immediately; reserve available Agent/API capacity for the primary L4 cohort, then fill genuine L4 gaps with already-authorized L2 work. A stagnant upload count is a downstream eligibility bottleneck, not proof of a slow upload page.
